siyuanUrlDesc: The other device's siyuan instance URL. eg: http://192.168.1.45:6806
siyuanApiKeyDesc: SiYuan API Key for the other device
siyuanNicknameDesc: A nickname for the peer device
syncOnOpenDesc: Sync with the remote when opening SiYuan
syncOnCloseDesc: Sync with the remote when closing SiYuan
instantSyncDesc: Enable immediate syncing of single modifications to the remote device without requiring a complete re-sync. This experimental feature allows the local device to send changes as soon as they're made, but may cause issues in some scenarios.
transactionsDebounceTimeDesc: The delay in milliseconds before auto-syncing a note after the last edit. Lower values increase sync frequency but also increase the bandwidth usage.
useExperimentalWebSocketDesc: Use a WebSocket connection for real-time synchronization. This feature is experimental and may be unstable.
trackConflictsDesc: When a file is modified on both devices since the last sync, the older version will be renamed as a conflict file instead of being overwritten.
syncCompletedWithConflicts: Sync completed with conflicts ({{duration}}s) - {{localModified}} modified locally, {{remoteModified}} modified remotely, {{localDeleted}} deleted locally, {{remoteDeleted}} deleted remotely
syncCompletedSuccessfully: Sync completed successfully! ({{duration}}s) - {{localModified}} modified locally, {{remoteModified}} modified remotely, {{localDeleted}} deleted locally, {{remoteDeleted}} deleted remotely
createDataSnapshotsDesc: Create a new data snapshot before syncing. This allows you to restore the data to the state before the sync if needed. The Data repo key needs to be set in the SiYuan settings.
initializeDataRepo: The {{remoteName}} data repository is not initialized. Unable to create the {{remoteName}} data snapshot.
minHoursBetweenSnapshotsDesc: The minimum number of hours between automatic data snapshots.
syncLockAlreadyExists: {{remoteName}} holds a sync lock created {{age}}s ago, so this sync was aborted. If no sync is running on either device, a previous sync was interrupted: delete `data/.siyuan/sync/lock` on that device and retry (locks older than 5 minutes are ignored automatically, and a leftover lock created by this device is taken over automatically).
syncIconInBreadcrumbDesc: Show the sync icon in document breadcrumb. You can toggle the top bar icon in the SiYuan settings.
replaceSyncButtonDesc: Replace the default SiYuan sync button with the Better Sync button.
getLastSyncLogDesc: Copy the last sync log to the assets folder. You can retrieve it from the missing assets section, or include it in a note and open it.
lastSyncMessageCopied: The last sync log ({{name}}) has been copied to the assets folder.
siyuanUrlBadScheme: Unsupported scheme “{{scheme}}”, only http / https are supported
testConnectionDesc: Check that the peer is reachable, the API key is accepted and the plugin directories are ready before syncing.
connectionSlowStart: First request took {{seconds}}s: the peer was probably waking up from sleep, which is normal.
connReasonTimeout: The peer did not answer within the timeout. When the peer is a phone/tablet this usually means SiYuan was backgrounded or the system suspended it — bring it to the foreground and retry, or increase “Request timeout”.
connReasonUnreachable: Cannot reach the peer: wrong address or port, “Network serving” disabled on the peer, or both devices are not on the same network.
connReasonUnauthorized: The API key is incorrect. Copy the key from the peer's SiYuan “Settings → About → API token”.
connReasonUnexpected: The peer returned an unexpected response — it may not be a SiYuan kernel, or the version is incompatible.
requestTimeoutMsDesc: How long a single request may take. For a phone/tablet peer 30000 or more is recommended (a sleeping device can need 7+ seconds for the first request).
syncFailedTimeoutHint: (hint: the peer may be asleep or in the background — bring the peer's SiYuan to the foreground and retry)
syncInterruptNote: Files that already transferred are kept; the next sync continues from where it stopped and never deletes data on the peer.
maxConcurrentRequestsDesc: How many file transfers/scans may run at the same time. Use 4~8 when the peer is a phone/tablet, 16 is fine on fast LAN devices. Takes effect when the dialog is confirmed.
connPeerRepoNotReady: The peer's data repository is not initialized, so pre-sync snapshots are unavailable. To use snapshots, initialize the data repo key on the peer under 设置 → 账号与同步 → 本地数据仓库.
connectionLocalTokenSourceConf: conf/conf.json (may lag behind the running kernel)
connectionLocalTokenHint: Note: the token in conf/conf.json was observed to be rejected by the kernel (401); use the value shown in 设置 → 关于 → API token.
connectionLocalTokenMissing: Could not read this device's API token: the peer needs it to connect back to this device when this device acts as the server.
snapshotRepoNotInitialized: The data repository of {{remoteName}} is not initialized, so the pre-sync snapshot was skipped. To get snapshots, initialize the data repo key on both devices (设置 → 账号与同步 → 本地数据仓库) and enable "Create data snapshots".
snapshotHintTitle: Take a snapshot before the first big sync
snapshotHintDesc: Before enabling "Create data snapshots", initialize the data repo key on both devices (设置 → 账号与同步 → 本地数据仓库). Snapshots let you roll the data back to its pre-sync state. The "Test connection" button above also reports whether the peer's repository is ready.
syncAlreadyRunning: A sync is already in progress{{progress}}, this click was ignored (see the progress panel in the bottom right). If it makes no progress, press ⏹ on the panel to abort it, or reload the plugin.
syncCancelled: Sync cancelled (what was already transferred is kept; the next sync continues from there).
progressCancellingNote: Waiting for the current request to end; what was already transferred is kept.
syncCancelledNote: Files that already transferred are kept; the next sync continues from where it stopped and never deletes data on the peer.
progressClose: Close this panel (it reappears on the next sync)
progressPauseUnavailable: The transfer is being cancelled, pause is unavailable.
progressPausedNote: Click ▶ to resume. Note: after a pause of more than 5 minutes the lock counts as stale and the other device may start syncing.
pairingQrTitle: Connection QR code (let another device connect to me)
pairingQrDesc: Packs this device's address and API token into a QR code: the other side uses "Scan / paste to connect" — no more copying IPs and tokens by hand. The address and token are self-tested before the code is produced. If scanning is inconvenient, just use "Copy connection text".
pairingQrPhoneHint: On a phone: ① scan this code with the system camera or WeChat → you get a bsync:v1:… text ② copy it ③ in the phone's SiYuan plugin settings press "Read from clipboard" (or paste it) → connect. If the phone's plugin supports in-app scanning, its camera button works too.
pairingImportDecoding: Reading the QR code from the image…
pairingImportDecodeFailed: No QR code found: get the code bigger in the frame, aim straight and avoid glare — or just use "Read from clipboard" / paste the text.
pairingImportPhotoNote: Note: "Scan by photo" takes a picture with the system camera (the SiYuan app saves it into the gallery — that is app behaviour). To avoid the photo, scan with the phone camera / WeChat and use "Read from clipboard". A device that was paired once can simply press "Connect" next time — not even a QR code is needed.
pairingImportClipboardFailed: Could not read the clipboard (permission denied): paste manually into the field below.
pairingQrWorking: Reading this device's address and token, then self-testing…
pairingQrReady: Done: let the other device scan the code, or send it the connection text below.
pairingQrNoToken: Could not read this device's API token, so no QR code was produced.
pairingQrTokenRejected: This device's API token failed the self-test (HTTP {{status}}): use the value shown in 设置 → 关于 → API token.
pairingQrUnverified: Warning: no address passed the self-test, falling back to {{urls}} (the peer may not reach it).
pairingImportTitle: Scan / paste to connect (join another device)
pairingImportDesc: Paste the text from the other device's QR code (or use the camera button): the address and token are filled in, the connection is verified, and the peer is saved to the list below.
pairingHistoryDesc: Devices that connected successfully are remembered by device fingerprint, so a changed IP is found again. Pin or delete as you like.
pairingHistoryEmpty: No paired device yet: connect once with the QR code or by pasting the text above.
pairingHistoryNoToken: this entry has no saved token, only the address was filled in; scan/paste once more to include the token
pairingReasonFingerprintMismatch: Those addresses answered from a different SiYuan device (the IP may have been taken over), please scan again.
pairingReasonUnauthorized: The peer rejected the token (401): it probably changed, scan/paste again.
pairingReasonTimeout: The peer did not answer in time: it may be asleep or on another network.
pairingReasonUnreachable: Cannot reach that address: wrong host/port, or "Network serving" is off on the peer.
pairingReasonNoInstanceId: That address did not answer like a SiYuan kernel (no device fingerprint).
pairingReasonNoCandidate: There is no address to try.
pairingProblemNotPairing: This text is not a better-sync pairing text.
pairingProblemBadJson: The JSON inside the pairing text could not be parsed — it may have been truncated when copied.
pairingProblemNoUrl: The pairing text contains no address.
pairingProblemNoToken: The pairing text contains no API token.
pairingProblemBadUrl: The pairing text contains an invalid address: {{detail}}
syncRoleTitle: Role of this device (who starts a sync)
syncRoleDesc: host = the pushing side: automatic sync allowed (on open/close, instant sync); peer = receiving side: never starts automatically, manual only; manual = never syncs automatically. When both sides are host, only the "direction owner" starts and the other side is stopped with an explanation. Default: host (same as older versions).
directionOwnerDesc: Only one side of a pair may start a sync, so the two cannot take turns overwriting each other. auto = decided by device fingerprint (both sides compute the same answer without talking); you can also force this device or the peer. Only used while this device's role is host.
roleStatusDesc: Press "Refresh" to read the role declarations of this device and the peer (data/.siyuan/sync/role.json).
roleStatusRemoteUnknown: Peer: no role declared (older plugin, or never connected)
roleStatusLocalUnknown: This device: not declared yet (default host)
roleStatusAdvice: Suggested: make the always-on device host and the other one peer.
syncRefusedBothHosts: Both sides are configured as host: by direction ownership "{{owner}}" should be the one syncing. Change "Role of this device" to peer on one of them (peer: {{peerName}} · {{peerUrl}}). No file was transferred.
syncRefusedBothPeers: Both sides are peer, so neither starts a sync: set one of them to host. No file was transferred.
syncRefusedLocalPeer: This device is a "peer" and does not start syncs (that is the setting, not a failure): set its role to host for automatic syncing. No file was transferred.
syncRefusedLocalManual: This device's role is "manual", so the automatic sync was skipped. No file was transferred.
syncRefusedUnknownPeer: The peer declares no role (probably an older plugin): the automatic sync was skipped to avoid the two sides pushing over each other. Connect once via "Scan / paste to connect", or press sync manually. No file was transferred.
syncScopeTitle: Selective sync (pick notebooks / directories / exclude rules)
syncScopeDesc: Unchecking stops comparing and transferring — it never deletes data on either side. Everything is selected by default (same as older versions); saved changes apply from the next sync.
syncScopeRules: Exclude files per directory (one per line: dir: wildcard, wildcard; supports * ? and **)
syncScopeSaved: Saved. It applies from the next sync.
syncScopeEffective: The scope is decided by the side that starts the sync (see the role and direction ownership above): whatever the owner has selected is what this session compares.
